subject.title: [Feature]: Make detached longwork final delivery ownership explicit

question: Should this issue remain the canonical thread for detached longwork final-delivery ownership, and which existing substrate should own the durable final-delivery obligation?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent API shape affects model-facing `sessions_spawn`, plugin hooks, persisted delivery state, and cross-channel routing semantics.

options.title: Extend existing subagent delivery state
options.body: Keep this issue canonical and design a narrow owner-mode contract on the current subagent registry/delivery state, preserving current defaults while adding live proof and docs.

options.title: Move to broader delivery-obligation design
options.body: Treat this as part of a larger outbox/ledger effort that unifies subagents, background tasks, and channel delivery confirmation before implementation.

options.title: Document current requester-key behavior only
options.body: Defer explicit owner modes and clarify that current `completionOwnerKey` is only requester-session routing, leaving cross-surface suppression to callers for now.

recommendation.title: Extend existing subagent delivery state
recommendation.body: Keep this issue canonical and design a narrow owner-mode contract on the current subagent registry/delivery state, preserving current defaults while adding live proof and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent current-main history around subagent delivery state, steering queue handoffs, and thread binding routes through steipete's commits and merges.
